verdicts.reason: A uses the portrait canvas fully and keeps the product and headline big, but its alignment is inconsistent. GROVE is centred, the headline and body copy are left-aligned, and the chips and CTA are pushed to the right edge, so the stack looks ragged. The chips and CTA also sit cramped against the right margin. B does share a clean left edge, but it leaves a dead empty band across the bottom fifth of the canvas. Its FREE DELIVERY badge floats awkwardly beside the body copy instead of in a corner. The headline wraps badly, leaving 'back' as an orphan, and the chip and CTA text has shrunk to a weak, small size.
